scope: Root-frozen engineering nonregression checks before A/B fitting; not universal reconstruction acceptance or official challenge tolerances.

skin_b_versus_a.metric_geometry: Actual native MHR hand-skin vertices against one frozen uncertain reconstructed convex object; mean depth over selected hand-skin vertices; phase maximum over per-frame maximum vertex depth.

required_manual_review: Original RGB versus A/B contact and release timing, especially251..300
Source-faithful opening and actual grasp changes, not just low predicted acceleration
Missing image support versus true occlusion; no new hidden-hand DOFs in B
No increased penetration or detachment concealed by phase/pose gates
limitations: Improved frozen-anchor distance, local slip or fitting objective alone cannot confirm beneficial contact or justify contact-model training.
Current camera, object shape and human/object relative scale remain reconstructed hypotheses.
Engineering booleans do not automatically accept quality, contact, scale, export or official scores.
No small-model training, EP11 execution or all30 batch is part of this first A/B run.
